newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says sales have improved so far '97.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says sales have improved so far '97.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker Volvo said on Tuesday it had seen a clear improvement in car sales in the first three months of 1997 compared with a year ago.
Figures for new car registrations in Western Europe from the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) showed on Tuesday that Volvo car registrations rose 40.5 percent in March to 21,822.
"We have a clear improvement so far this year... but we cannot give any forecasts ahead of our quarterly report next week (April 23)," company spokesman Ingmar Hesslefors told Reuters.
